responsibility: This file implements GCC’s RTL web construction and pseudo-register splitting pass, run when -fweb is enabled. It uses the dataflow framework (defs, uses, reaching-definition and use-def chains, and recog match_dup information) to union defs and uses of pseudos into independent “webs” via union-find, then assigns each web either the original pseudo or a freshly generated pseudo register and rewrites RTL references accordingly. Its responsibility is to break a single pseudo with multiple independent live ranges into separate pseudos so later RTL optimizations and register allocation can treat them independently; unlike generic dataflow or copy propagation passes, it specifically builds equivalence classes of def/use occurrences and renames registers to expose optimization opportunities.
